_IN ENGLISH—IRISH DICTIONARY_

rack1, s.(Cloud-)rack, scamaillmplreatha.

rack2, s.Togotorackandruin, dulchunraice; dulinainriocht.

rack3, s.1Racam. F: Toliveatrackandmanger, saolnabhfuíollabheithagat. Music-rack, racaceoil. Luggagerack, racabagáiste. 2Mec.E: Rackandpinion, racaaguspinniún.

rack4, s.Hist: Racam (céasta).F: Tobeontherack, bheithibpianpháis.

rack5, v.tr.1aHist: Racálaim. b(Ofpain, etc.) Ciapann, céasann. Toberackedbyremorse, dochroíabheithábhriseadhlehaithreachas. cTorackamachinetopieces, inneallaraiceáil. S.a. BRAIN1 2\. 2aCuirimainchíosar (thalamh, dhuine). bSpíonaim (ithir).

rack6, v.tr.Torack (off) wine, fíonatharraingt; fíonascagadhónmoirt.
